name: Flare
note: Electric orange gloss paint with a black carbon collar and butt cap, and a black textured sport grip. Loud and sporty. Look from: Predator P3 Flare and BK Rush.

forearm.prompt: The forearm is mostly glossy electric orange paint (#FF5A12, with deeper #D8400A and bright #FF8A3A tones and a faint fine speckle): about three quarters of the area stays orange. Across it run bold black racing graphics (#141414): five or six sharp angular black slash stripes that sweep diagonally from lower left to upper right across the whole length, some wide and some thin, with notched cut corners and a few thin orange outlines inside the black, like a sports car livery. Only at the far right end do the black stripes widen into a small patch of black snakeskin scales. The two thin strips at the far left are the joint collar: paint them black carbon-fibre weave (#1C1C1C to #3A3A3A) with a thin orange line (#FF5A12) at their right edge.

butt.prompt: Left thin strip (the ring): flat bright orange (#FF7A2A). The wrap (from the ring to the next zone line): a black textured sport grip of small overlapping diamond-shaped snakeskin scales in neat rows (#101010 to #2E2E2E), the same all over. The butt sleeve (between the two zone lines on the right): glossy black (#141414) with two bold orange (#FF5A12) angular slash stripes forming a sharp V-shaped chevron pointing to the left, with thin orange outlines. The very thin strip at the far right: plain black.

shaft_top.prompt: Glossy electric orange paint (#FF5A12, with deeper #D8400A and bright #FF8A3A tones). Bold black (#141414) racing spear graphics grow from the right edge (where the joint collar is) toward the left: two or three long sharp black spear shapes, wide at the right edge (together covering about half the height there) and tapering to needle points about two thirds of the way to the left, each outlined inside by a thin bright orange line, with a few thin black pinstripes running parallel to them. The left quarter of the panel is plain orange with only the thin needle tips of the black stripes. The graphics run along the length, slightly diagonal.

Trail.Note: The white wisp tinted (Config.Effects style row).

Pocket.Note: The default gust in the ball's colour.
